scope: Manual reading of three actual final-artifact images, plus inspection of all 16 measured home/document layouts. CSS root-text enlargement is recorded explicitly; this is not a claim of operating Chrome browser zoom or Linux CI.
observations: German home at 320px/200% and documentation at 390px/200% retain legible wrapping and in-viewport native menus; longer theme/navigation controls wrap onto a second row. The open menu intentionally overlays the body.
